A Blight spreads across the land: plausible-but-false knowledge that grows when nobody checks it.
Walk the map with the arrow keys (or WASD) and press Enter on a gate. The gold **▶ NEXT** marker is the suggested next stop. The map shows only the places on your path. More appear as you clear quests, or choose “Show the whole map” to see everything.
